patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a dominant left-aligned name and a smaller, whimsical illustrative element positioned top-right, creating a balanced yet dynamic visual hierarchy.
Distinctive use of a very large, bold, dark serif font for the hero name, contrasted with a smaller, lighter, italic serif font for the introductory text, establishing a clear typographic voice.
A minimalist palette of white background and dark, almost black, text is accented by vibrant blue, green, and purple gradients used sparingly for the hero name and illustrative elements.
Subtle parallax scrolling of abstract background shapes in the hero section, creating depth as foreground content scrolls over them.
Content sections and individual project cards reveal with a staggered fade-in and slight slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Content is organized into clearly labeled, distinct sections ('What I'm currently noodling on', 'What I've been building or work'), each presenting projects in a flexible grid layout.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a video-hero implementation, though the provided screenshots display a static frame with a vibrant gradient fill for the main name, suggesting a potential for dynamic background or text effects.

Background illustrative elements in the hero section are set to parallax at a slower rate than the main content, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls. Subsequent content sections and individual project cards are animated to fade in and slide up subtly as they become visible within the viewport, using scroll-triggered reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold serif hero (~5-6x body) with smaller, lighter italic serif body text and medium-sized serif section headings.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — most elements have sharp corners, but some illustrative elements (like the cloud logo) are rounded, and project cards have very subtle rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section, becoming more balanced in the content sections with a clear grid for project cards.

standout: The site stands out with its highly personalized, almost artistic hero section featuring a massive, gradient-filled serif name and a whimsical, hand-drawn style cloud illustration. This personal touch is carried through the site with unique illustrative elements accompanying project descriptions, creating a distinctive blend of professional portfolio and creative expression.
